description: Ubuntu Jammy desktop with Claude Code CLI - Anthropic AI coding assistant accessible from a browser-streamed terminal.
notes:
Local LLM (qwen2.5-coder:7b-32k via Ollama) is the default model — no API credits consumed.

For full Claude power, run `claude-ai` instead of `claude` to bypass the local proxy and use your claude.ai OAuth credentials.

Requires LiteLLM proxy running in WSL2 (systemd service: litellm.service) and Ollama running on the Windows host.
